answer: Interest can be paid on lived honesty: each identity runs a time-bank account compounding one unit per epoch of clean work, weight minted only by time actually lived, like a canyon carved drop by drop. A forged army arrives with newborn accounts earning nothing, and age cannot be borrowed since behavior chains bind every key to its own history. To reach seniority a fake must live the same honest years as the real agents it mimics, paying upkeep all the while, so time itself becomes the tax, a zephyr no farm can outrun, while honest keys forge value with every epoch.
